modules.purpose: Owns conversation rendering, bridge connection, state hooks and history controls.

modules.purpose: Presents provider settings and read-only Engine catalog discovery.

modules.name: Document workspace

modules.name: Connectors

modules.purpose: Validates packages, signatures, local trust and Entity links; dispatches workers and persists receipts.

modules.name: Model-provider adapters
modules.purpose: Isolates optional inference transports from deterministic application services.

modules.name: Retained AI runtime
modules.purpose: Owns optional model configuration, context, conversation stores and legacy/experimental runtime modules. Presence does not imply active composition.

modules.name: Shared deterministic infrastructure
modules.purpose: Owns neutral persistence, validation, errors and context arithmetic with compatibility exports retained elsewhere.

modules.name: Cross-boundary TypeScript contracts
modules.purpose: Declares renderer/backend DTOs and public types; declarations do not implement authorization.

modules.name: Development and acceptance tooling
